commercial.licenseLabel: Scoped assessments, production pilots and ongoing delivery partnerships

listing.description:
SocraTech is an AI and systems engineering practice focused on modernising complex software and operational environments without forcing organisations into risky, all-at-once rewrites.

The work spans legacy code modernisation, workflow automation, document intelligence, production AI architecture, governance and technical delivery. AI is used where it creates leverage, while deterministic tools, explicit system boundaries, observability and human review remain central to high-stakes workflows.

Engagements are typically structured around a contained feasibility or architecture assessment, followed by a production pilot with clear success criteria. Proven patterns can then be expanded across systems and teams with repeatable architecture, operational controls, runbooks and knowledge transfer.

SocraTech also develops reusable product infrastructure for configurable AI agents, persistent memory, structured tool use and auditable multi-step workflows. This gives client work a practical foundation in systems that have been built and operated, not just advisory material.

The core aim is straightforward: reduce manual work, improve delivery speed and auditability, and modernise systems in a way that can be supported after launch.
features: AI-assisted legacy refactoring and modular redesign
Deterministic workflow automation and tool-bound agent systems
Feasibility studies and production pilot delivery
Incremental modernisation without disruptive platform rewrites
listing.summary: SocraTech helps organisations modernise legacy codebases, operational workflows and knowledge systems using structured, production-grade AI. Engagements focus on controlled pilots, deterministic automation, governed document intelligence and measurable operational improvement rather than disruptive platform rewrites.
